notes: Fix: when a CV mentions only one role of a promotion (for example the later title), it now still shows the whole stay at that company, with both titles and the full dates.

New in the studio: Applications, a private list of the jobs you've applied for, with status, follow-up dates, notes and the tailored link you sent. It's saved in your private repository (needs the private master connected).
Tailored links and Applications show how many people opened each link, when your private repository runs the hourly visit-count workflow.
